artifact_review: The Router flagged general blur (severity 2) and water surface texture anomaly (severity 1). However, this is a subtle issue in an otherwise high-quality silhouette. My previous score of 3.92 was too lenient given the explicit expert hint to distinguish optical blur from AI artifacts; the edge softness leans slightly toward AI generation. A score closer to 3.5 better reflects this ambiguity without over-penalizing natural underwater conditions.
